action_design.description: Renewable-load-first dispatch with executed ESS flow semantics plus one heterogeneous controllable-load intent per microgrid.

common_random_numbers.definition: same dates, initial SOC configuration, and per-day environment seeds

vs_idle.formula: Dueling Feasible Actor profit - Idle profit; positive means Dueling Feasible Actor is better

vs_dr_reference.formula: Dueling Feasible Actor profit - Deterministic rule-based DR reference profit; positive means Dueling Feasible Actor is better

vs_independent_milp.formula: Dueling Feasible Actor profit - Independent MILP profit; positive means Dueling Feasible Actor is better

vs_cooperative_milp.formula: Dueling Feasible Actor profit - Cooperative MILP profit; positive means Dueling Feasible Actor is better

definition.feasible_day: existing physical constraint feasibility; semantics unchanged
definition.strict_feasible_day: physical feasibility plus zero unmet/DR failures and applicable HVAC, mill, and EV service constraints under service_metrics_v2
definition.unmet_load_hour_rate: fraction of test-day hours where any microgrid has unmet load
definition.unmet_load_microgrid_hour_rate: fraction of microgrid-hours with unmet load across all microgrids
definition.dr_supply_infeasible_rate: fraction of test-day hours where any microgrid reports dr_supply_infeasible
